channel.title: Agri & fertilisers · Market Pressure Map
channel.description: Daily news scored for its impact on Agri & fertilisers in Indian markets. Today: strong tailwind (+3.8).

item.title: [+2] IMD weather update: ‘Yellow’ alert issued for Andhra, Odisha as Cyclone Akvan turns ‘very severe’ ahead of landfall
item.description:
Signal: good monsoon and sowing. 5 reports from The New Indian Express, The Star, BusinessToday Malaysia and 2 more. Related: “1,643 slopes nationwide at very high risk of landslides ahead of monsoon season, says Ahmad Maslan”. Turn: earlier readings (15 Nov) pointed the other way.

Agri & fertilisers: tailwind (+2) — Better harvests and farm incomes

Why it matters: Good rains lift harvests and rural incomes, supporting farm, rural consumer and tractor demand and easing food inflation.

Market gauges: Inflation outlook +1, Growth outlook +1

Confidence: medium · horizon: months

item.title: [+1] ‘We hope to start FTA talks in 90 days’: Goyal on India-Egypt trade deal
item.description:
Signal: trade deal or tariff relief for India (India). 10 reports from Daily News Egypt, The New Indian Express, Swarajya and 7 more. Related: “India, Egypt weigh startup access clause in trade pact”. Ongoing: also reported on 5 of the previous 7 days (first 12 Nov).

Agri & fertilisers: mild tailwind (+1) — Farm exports gain access

Why it matters: Lower tariffs or a trade deal open markets for Indian exporters and attract investment into export manufacturing.

Market gauges: Growth outlook +1, Rupee +1, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) +1

Confidence: high · horizon: months

item.title: [+1] Indias Wholesale Inflation Hits 12.29% As Rising Fuel And Food Prices Put Middle-Class Household Budgets
item.description:
Signal: higher global food prices (global). 4 reports from The New Indian Express, Hyderabad Mail, Free Press Journal and 1 more. Related: “Euronext wheat climbs on euro weakness and Black Sea disruption By Investing.com”. Ongoing: also reported on 2 of the previous 7 days (first 12 Nov).

Agri & fertilisers: mild tailwind (+1) — Export prices firm

Why it matters: Dearer world food, edible oil and fertiliser raise India's import costs and food inflation.

Market gauges: Inflation outlook −1, Fiscal & trade balance −1

Confidence: medium · horizon: months

item.title: [+1] Food Price Surge Pushes Retail Inflation Past RBI’s 6% Limit
item.description:
Signal: rising Indian food prices (India). 3 reports from TheWire.in, BW Businessworld, Business Standard. Related: “Food Inflation Rises To 8.9%, RBI May Hike Rates Twice By 25 Bps Each: Report”. Ongoing: also reported on 2 of the previous 7 days (first 12 Nov).

Agri & fertilisers: mild tailwind (+1) — Better farm-gate prices

Why it matters: Food carries a large weight in India's CPI, so rising food prices squeeze household budgets and limit the RBI's room to cut rates.

Market gauges: Inflation outlook −3, Bond market (G-Secs) −1

Confidence: medium · horizon: months
